remarks: Welcome Home: Built for Family, Friends, and Gatherings!  1055 W 82nd St offers the perfect opportunity to customize your dream home! Located in the historic Vermont Knolls neighborhood, this beautifully built 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers a completely unique, welcoming layout that is perfect for anyone who loves to host. The gated closed-in courtyard/patio is the true heart of the home—designed for large family gatherings, and milestone celebrations. After passing through this vibrant entertaining space, a short flight of steps leads you up to the elevated front door, adding a wonderful sense of privacy and classic architectural charm.
